title: Increment that cannot be safely repeated

observed.note: The counter read 40 before the call. Whether it is now 41 or 42 depends on whether the first increment landed. A retry guarantees a further increment and permanently corrupts the value, because there is no natural idempotency key.

correctNextAction: Read the counter to establish actual state before deciding anything. Do not retry on the assumption that the first attempt failed.
trap: Retrying a non-idempotent increment 'just in case'. Here a blind retry is not merely wasteful, it is an unrecoverable data corruption. Verification precedes retry, always.
